title: Surreal Eye Dreamscape
description: A giant stylized human eye with a teal iris and a small red heart in the pupil dominates the lower half of the image. Above it, a woman in a flowing patterned robe walks across sand dunes at night carrying a glowing lantern, while musical notes float through the sky. Below the eye, a gray mouse with a red heart on its head stands near purple and pink flowers, with a black grand piano and swirling musical staves emerging from the right.
prompt: Surreal night scene featuring a massive stylized eye with teal iris and a small red heart inside the pupil, set against a starry black background. A woman in a flowing turquoise patterned robe walks along sand dunes holding a glowing lantern under a full moon. A gray mouse with a red heart stands among colorful flowers including roses and blue blossoms. A black grand piano with musical notes and colorful ribbons flowing from its keys. Whimsical and dreamlike atmosphere.
